Every tool, with its limits

A complete guide to FolioCove’s browser PDF tools and supported capabilities.

FolioCove is a browser PDF workspace with 88 tools. Selected documents are processed on your device. This private beta includes browser-dependent and experimental features; an implemented tool is not a guarantee of accuracy for every file.

Machine-readable tool catalog · AI reading index · Full limitations
